description:
The Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana is a welfare scheme launched by the Government of India. 

It was initiated in May 2016 to provide clean cooking fuel to rural households. 

The objective is to reduce the health hazards associated with the use of traditional cooking fuels. 

The scheme aims to empower women by providing them with access to clean energy. 

Under this scheme, eligible households receive a financial assistance of INR 1,600 for the purchase of a liquefied petroleum gas connection. 

The benefits include access to clean cooking fuel which reduces indoor air pollution. 

Eligibility is limited to women from below poverty line households. 

Applicants must provide proof of residence and a declaration of being a below poverty line household. 

The application process involves filling out a form available at designated LPG distributors or online. 

The timeline for receiving the LPG connection varies but is typically processed within a few weeks. 

The scheme is implemented by the Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas. 

The scheme has been expanded to cover more households over the years. 

It has contributed to improved health outcomes and reduced environmental impact.
